metric_definitions.batter_runs: Sum of source runs for the striker; source anomaly semantics remain documented.
metric_definitions.strike_rate: 100 * batter runs / batter balls faced; wides are not balls faced.
metric_definitions.boundary_percentage: 100 * source four/six flags / batter balls faced.
metric_definitions.bowling_economy: 6 * bowler-conceded runs / legal balls; byes, leg-byes, and penalty extras are excluded.
metric_definitions.pressure_strike_rate: 100 * batter runs on batting-pressure balls / batter balls faced in batting pressure.
metric_definitions.pressure_economy: 6 * bowler-conceded runs in bowling pressure / legal balls in bowling pressure.
metric_definitions.SPI: Existing role-specific score: 60% baseline-relative performance component, 20% match-level consistency, and 20% exposure reliability. Performance is a tanh-scaled competition-adjusted pressure-minus-normal difference; reliability is 100 * opportunities / (opportunities + 30). Rankings require at least 3 pressure matches and 12 role-specific pressure balls. All choices remain provisional.
metric_definitions.consistency: 100 / (1 + sample coefficient of variation) of match-level pressure strike rates for batters or pressure economy rates for bowlers.
metric_definitions.pressure: Existing role-specific weighted 0–100 heuristic with threshold 50; first-innings and chase states use separate normalizations. This is not a win probability.
metric_definitions.dot_ball_percentage: 100 * source-defined batter dot balls / balls faced.

pressure_methodology.normalization: Run-rate, wickets, innings-time and match-closeness components are bounded or exponential pre-delivery state features. Chases compare required run rate with the reference rate; first innings compare current run rate with that reference.
pressure_methodology.reference_rate: Historical median first-innings rate within format where available, with existing documented format fallback.
